fidelity: F2a — Single-Basin Solar Still, Dunkle Lumped Energy Balance
source: Dunkle, R.V. (1961) 'Solar water distillation', Int. Developments in Heat Transfer, ASME, pp.895-902; Tiwari & Tiwari (2007) 'Solar Distillation Practice for Water Desalination Systems'; Cooper, P.I. (1973) Solar Energy 12:313-331

unit.name: Generic single-basin double-slope solar still (1 m2)

A_basin.note: Basin / water surface area (Tiwari 2007 typical bench still)

A_glass.note: Glass cover area (slightly larger than basin)

m_water.note: Basin water mass (20 mm depth over 1 m2)

cp_water.note: Specific heat of saline water (~seawater, CRC)

m_glass.note: Glass cover mass (4 mm float glass, 2500 kg/m3)

alpha_water.note: Fraction of transmitted solar absorbed in water+basin (Cooper 1973)

eps_glass.note: Long-wave emissivity of glass inner surface

h_glass_amb.note: Outer glass-to-ambient combined convective+radiative coeff (Cooper 1973, wind ~2 m/s)

U_basin_amb.note: Basin (bottom+side) heat loss coefficient to ambient, insulated still (Tiwari 2007)
